meta.title: Withdrawing Order...: A reason containing only spaces is handled consistently

plan.title: Closed RFQ withdrawal with spaces-only reason

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its Responses tab.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses view where the Settings control is available.
Open the RFQ stage withdrawal dialog, enter five spaces as the reason, and confirm to observe Procol's handling.
Verify that the withdrawal window remains visible after the spaces-only reason is submitted.
